title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.05.4
notes:
- Make It Fit now combines MiniBPM tempo analysis with Lemon Studio's onset detector and explicit BPM labels, with safeguards for silence, steady tones and ambiguous rhythmic estimates.
- Select Playlist audio stems and run Make It Fit on a selected reference clip to apply one timing ratio to the selection, preserving clip start positions and using pitch-preserving Pro stretching.
- Channel Rack sample menus and Lemon Sampler's Time menu now offer tempo detection, Make It Fit, source BPM entry, beat/bar lengths and Reset stretching. Fitting works without a Playlist clip and supports Undo.
- Piano Roll Stretch is an independent toggle alongside Pencil and Brush. Drag a selected note's right edge to scale the selected notes' timing and lengths; note bodies retain group movement. Right-click empty space to turn Stretch off.
- The Piano Roll Control/Velocity menu draws above editor frames, opens upward when needed and stays inside the application window, including at larger interface scales.
- Original, Clean Modern and Analog mixer finishes now also style native Channel Strip mixer controls while preserving hosted third-party plugin appearance.
- Playlist clip gain handles use clearer pointing-finger cursor feedback. Amplified waveforms stay within the clip audio body and no longer cover clip titles.
